question: Under which Article of the Directive Principles of State Policy, a working woman on maternity leave, must receive all maternity benefits from the employer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 42**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 42** states that the State shall make provisions for securing just and humane conditions of work and for **maternity relief**.
 
• This means that a working woman on** maternity leave** is entitled to receive all **maternity benefits** from her employer, as mandated by law.
 
• **Maternity benefits **may include **paid leave, medical expenses, and other allowances**.
 
• It is important for employers to comply with these provisions to ensure the **well-being and protection** of working mothers and their children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 44, states that the State shall endeavor to secure for the citizens a** uniform civil code **throughout the territory of India. 
 
• **Article 45,** states that the State shall endeavor to provide **free and compulsory education** to all children until they complete the age of fourteen years.
 
• **Article 43**, states that the State shall endeavor to secure for workers a **living wage,** conditions of work ensuring a decent standard of life, and full enjoyment of leisure and **social and cultural opportunities..**
